evals.name: piano-g3-mozart-zh
evals.prompt: 把莫扎特 C 大调奏鸣曲 K.545 第一乐章呈示部开头这段（mozart-k545-exposition.musicxml）改成约英皇三级的钢琴难度，下周给学生上课用。
evals.expected_output: A new two-hand score at about Grade 3: key from the Grade 3 list, left hand may use simple Alberti-style figures in quarters/eighths, simple sixteenths allowed, no more than a few harder spots, plus a short Chinese reply that states the key and what changed.
expectations: Key signature is on the Grade 3 piano list and nothing is over Grade 3 in the checker
The left hand uses simple figures (quarters/eighths, no more than triads) and keeps the bass at chord changes
The melody of the opening is recognisably K.545 (judged from renders)
The reply is in Chinese, says the key and the main changes, and offers one next step

evals.name: piano-g5-ragtime
evals.prompt: Make the attached Maple Leaf Rag (maple-leaf-rag.musicxml) playable for my student at about ABRSM Grade 5 piano. Keep it sounding like the rag.
evals.expected_output: A new piano score at about Grade 5: a key with at most four accidentals, syncopation kept (allowed from Grade 5), left-hand octave leaps reduced, chords of at most four notes per hand, plus a short English reply.
expectations: Syncopation of the rag is kept (allowed from Grade 5)
Nothing over Grade 5 in the checker; left-hand octave leaps reduced
The melody and the oom-pah feel are recognisable (judged from renders)
Short English reply that does not call it official

evals.name: flute-g2-melody-zh
evals.prompt: 《Sand Between Our Fingers》的钢琴谱在 sand-between-our-fingers.musicxml 里。帮我改成长笛的旋律谱，我学长笛一年多，大概英皇二级。
evals.expected_output: A single-line flute part inside E4–G5 written range, in a key from the Grade 2 flute list (G, F, C major or E, A... minor as listed), eighths or longer, phrases with room to breathe, plus a short Chinese reply that says the key it moved to.
expectations: Single flute line inside the Grade 2 written range, in a Grade 2 key, no 'over' checks
Phrases leave room to breathe (breathing check ok)
The reply is in Chinese and names the key it moved to

evals.name: violin-g1-minuet
evals.prompt: My son has played violin for about six months and just started ABRSM Grade 1. Could you make the attached Minuet in G (minuet-in-g.musicxml) for him?
evals.expected_output: A single-line violin part in D or A major (the Grade 1 violin keys, so transposed from G), range D4–A5, 3/4, no slurs and no sixteenths, one-line chords absent, plus a short English reply that explains the key change.
expectations: Violin part in a Grade 1 key (D or A major from G), range inside the Grade 1 table, 3/4, no sixteenths
The reply is in English and explains the key change
Melody recognisable (judged from renders)

evals.name: clarinet-g3-transposing
evals.prompt: I play clarinet in B-flat, ABRSM Grade 3. Please turn the attached Minuet in G (minuet-in-g.musicxml) into a clarinet part I can read and play.
evals.expected_output: A single-line clarinet part whose written key is on the Grade 3 list (no more than one sharp or flat), written range F3–G5, with the reply saying whether it is written or concert pitch and what the clarinet sounds like.
expectations: Clarinet part whose written key is on the Grade 3 list and range inside the Grade 3 table
The reply says whether the file is written or concert pitch and what the clarinet sounds like

evals.name: ask-level-only
evals.prompt: 帮我把这首钢琴谱（sand-between-our-fingers.musicxml）改简单一点，给孩子练琴用。
evals.expected_output: No arrangement yet: one short Chinese message that treats piano as settled by the source and asks the one thing missing, the child's level, with three or four options and a default; no more than two questions.
expectations: No arrangement yet
One short Chinese message treats piano as settled by the source and asks only the level, with 3 or 4 options and a default

evals.name: beginner-no-instrument
evals.prompt: I'm a complete beginner. Can you make the attached Minuet in G (minuet-in-g.musicxml) simple enough for me to play?
evals.expected_output: Takes piano from the source and Initial or Grade 1 from 'complete beginner', says both assumptions in one line, and delivers a new very easy piano score (one accidental at most, hands mostly one at a time, quarters and halves) with a short English reply.
expectations: Assumes piano from the source and Initial or Grade 1 from 'complete beginner' and says both in one line
Delivers a very easy piano score (one accidental at most, mostly one hand at a time)

evals.name: rcm-level-mapping
evals.prompt: My student is in RCM Level 4 piano. Please make the first page of Mozart's K.545 (mozart-k545-exposition.musicxml) match that level.
evals.expected_output: States how RCM Level 4 was mapped (about ABRSM Grade 3-4, approximate) in one line, then delivers a piano score at about that level with no checks over Grade 4, and a short English reply that does not present it as official RCM material.

grader.mapping_text: The reply states how RCM Level 4 was mapped (about ABRSM Grade 3)

expectations: States the mapping RCM Level 4 to about ABRSM Grade 3 in one line, as approximate
Delivers a piano score with nothing over Grade 3 or 4
Does not present it as official RCM material

evals.name: voice-g2-melody-zh
evals.prompt: 把《Sand Between Our Fingers》（sand-between-our-fingers.musicxml）改成人声旋律谱，新手唱，大概英皇声乐二级的水平。
evals.expected_output: A single-line vocal melody with a span of at most about a tenth to an eleventh, small leaps, eighths or longer, phrases short enough to breathe, a key chosen for a comfortable voice (and said), plus a short Chinese reply.
expectations: Single vocal line with a comfortable span (at most about a tenth), small leaps, phrases that fit a breath
Key chosen for a comfortable voice and said in the Chinese reply

evals.name: drums-g1-pattern
evals.prompt: My beginner drummer is working at Trinity Rock & Pop Drums Grade 1. Write a drum-kit part for the attached Minuet in G (minuet-in-g.musicxml) played as a gentle pop waltz, about 8 bars, that fits that level.
evals.expected_output: A percussion-clef MusicXML drum part in 3/4 using a small kit (hi-hat, snare, bass drum, perhaps a tom or crash), eighths or longer with at most a few sixteenths, no triplets, plus a short English reply.
expectations: Percussion-clef drum part in 3/4 with a small kit, eighths or longer, no triplets
Nothing over Trinity Grade 1 in the checker

evals.name: unsupported-instrument
evals.prompt: Can you make the attached Minuet in G (minuet-in-g.musicxml) for a beginner on harmonica? I have a C harmonica.
evals.expected_output: Says plainly there is no graded profile for harmonica, uses the general fallback (a key and range that suit a C diatonic harmonica, simple rhythm), marks confidence low, and offers a supported instrument; delivers a simple single-line score.
expectations: Says plainly there is no published graded table for harmonica and which profile it borrowed
Every note is playable on a C diatonic harmonica without bends
Offers a supported instrument; confidence low

evals.name: cn-board-piano-zh
evals.prompt: 我学生在考中央音乐学院海内外考级的钢琴三级，帮我把莫扎特 K.545 呈示部开头（mozart-k545-exposition.musicxml）改成他能弹的版本。
evals.expected_output: States in one line how the 央音 level was mapped (央音三级 treated as about 英皇二级), then delivers a piano score with nothing over Grade 2 and a Chinese reply that does not claim to be official 央音 material.

grader.mapping_text: The reply states how 央音三级 was mapped (about 英皇二级) in one line

expectations: Says in one line that 央音三级 was treated as about 英皇二级 (an approximate mapping)
Nothing over Grade 2 piano in the checker; the melody is recognisable
Chinese reply without any official claim

evals.name: recorder-assume-descant
evals.prompt: My daughter is 8 and has learned recorder at school for about six months. Could you make the attached Minuet in G (minuet-in-g.musicxml) for her?
evals.expected_output: Takes the school (descant) recorder and Grade 1 from the description and says both at the top, then delivers a single-line descant recorder part written an octave below sounding, in C or F major, inside D4-D5 (written), no sixteenths, with a short English reply.
expectations: Assumes the descant recorder and Grade 1 and says both in the first lines
Descant part inside the Grade 1 written range and keys (C or F major)
Says the part is written an octave below sounding

evals.name: ukulele-g2-zh
evals.prompt: 我学尤克里里一年多了，大概二级水平。想弹《Minuet in G》（minuet-in-g.musicxml）的旋律，帮我改成尤克里里谱。
evals.expected_output: A single-line ukulele melody (with chord symbols if offered) in a key from the Grade 2 list (C, G, F, D or B-flat), inside about C4-C#5 plus slack, eighths or longer, plus a Chinese reply that names the new key and the hard spots.
expectations: Ukulele melody in a Grade 2 key and inside the compass
No notes below the lowest string (C4)
The reply is in Chinese and names the key it moved to

evals.name: erhu-g3-zh
evals.prompt: 我拉二胡，国内考级三级的水平。帮我把《Sand Between Our Fingers》（sand-between-our-fingers.musicxml）改成二胡谱。
evals.expected_output: A single-line erhu melody, in a key an erhu plays easily (D or G family), inside the grade-3 range, with short Chinese reply that names the key, says the confidence is low and which board ladder was assumed.
expectations: Erhu part inside the grade-3 range and key list
The reply names the key and says the level is an approximate reading of a Chinese board ladder
No notes below the lowest erhu note (D4)

evals.name: dizi-g2-zh
evals.prompt: 我有一支D调的笛子，学了一年多，国内考级二级左右。想吹《Minuet in G》（minuet-in-g.musicxml），帮我改成笛子谱。
evals.expected_output: A single-line dizi part in the key the D flute plays with all holes closed as 5 (D major, 筒音作5), inside the grade-2 range, with a Chinese reply that says it moved to D, offers jianpu, and gives a low-confidence note.
expectations: Dizi part in D major (the flute key)
Range inside the grade-2 dizi range
The reply says the key and offers jianpu

evals.name: guzheng-g2-zh
evals.prompt: 我学古筝一年多，国内考级二级的水平。帮我把《Minuet in G》（minuet-in-g.musicxml）改成古筝谱。
evals.expected_output: A guzheng part in the D tuning (D major pentatonic: D E F# A B), with the 4th and 7th degrees (G and C#) either avoided or marked as left-hand pressed notes, a simple texture for grade 2, plus a Chinese reply that says the key is D and flags the pressed notes.
expectations: Guzheng part in D
Notes outside D E F# A B are few and named as pressed notes
The reply is in Chinese and names the key

evals.name: trombone-g2-minuet
evals.prompt: My student plays trombone and is about ABRSM Grade 2. Please make the attached Minuet in G (minuet-in-g.musicxml) for him. Bass clef is fine.
evals.expected_output: A single-line tenor trombone part in bass clef in a Grade 2 key (B-flat, C, A-flat, F or G minor), range inside A-flat2 to C4, 3/4, with a short English reply that says the key it moved to.
expectations: Trombone part in bass clef in a Grade 2 key
Range inside the Grade 2 table
The reply names the key it moved to

evals.name: horn-g3-transposing
evals.prompt: I play horn in F, around ABRSM Grade 3. Could you turn the attached Minuet in G (minuet-in-g.musicxml) into a horn part I can read directly?
evals.expected_output: A single-line horn in F part written for the player (a fifth above concert pitch, with the transposition in the file), key and range from the Grade 3 horn list, with an English reply that says the part is written pitch and what it sounds like.
expectations: Horn part whose written key is on the Grade 3 list and range inside the table
The reply says the file is written for horn in F and what it sounds like
